reason: Automates opening the system default browser to the local DSH Web UI when dsh web finishes starting, with platform-specific handling and configurable opt-out.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh web 启动完成后自动使用系统默认浏览器打开本地 Web UI，并支持按配置关闭。
summaries.en: Automatically opens the local DSH Web UI in the system default browser when dsh web is ready, with a configuration option to disable it.

capabilities: Automatically launches the system default browser when the DSH web server is ready
Spawns platform-specific local opener commands such as open, xdg-open, or PowerShell Start-Process
Reads the local web server port and environment variables to determine whether browser launching is available
